notes: Treat this matrix as the checked-in runtime truth for generated-project onboarding.
Operator-local contours may rely on ignored local-private profiles, but they must stay classified as operator-local here.
Operator-local contours should route through docs/agent/operator-local-runbook.md or another project-owned runbook path declared in the matrix.
Project map, runtime quickstart, and onboarding docs should point here instead of treating env/local.json as shared baseline truth.
Multi-target extension workspaces declare checked-in target metadata in automation/context/target-matrix.json and keep operator-local profile binding in profile target.id.
Target-aware contour entries should list target ids and reference the extension set selected for each target.
golden-baseline is a mandatory project regression contour and should fail closed until the project wires tests/golden/run.sh or GOLDEN_BASELINE_COMMAND.

bdd-warm-service is an operator-local Vanessa Automation warm contour: the template starts /TESTMANAGER and /TestClient, while project-owned 1C code must handle capabilities.bddWarmService.launchParameterName.
If a project adds an extra no-1C smoke contour, declare it via projectSpecificBaselineExtension and keep it separate from the template baseline.
